story.title: Sepatu Merah Lala Ingin Berlari
story.author: BacaYuk Studio
story.moralMessage: Perjalanan yang paling berarti adalah perjalanan yang memberi kesempatan untuk berbuat baik.
story.description: Lala dan Sepatu Merah berlari ke taman, melompati genangan, lalu membantu seekor anak kucing menemukan induknya.

pages.title: Menunggu di Rak
pages.text: Di atas rak, Sepatu Merah menunggu. Setiap hari ia melihat pintu. “Kapan, ya, aku bisa berlari?” pikirnya.
pages.illustrationPrompt: A pair of small cherry-red children's sneakers with cream soles and two tiny friendly golden dot eyes on the outer sides sits neatly together on a low wooden shoe rack beside a sunny front door, looking eager toward the outdoors, cozy Indonesian family home entryway, warm morning light, soft hand-painted 2D children's picture-book illustration, rounded shapes, subtle paper texture, no text.

pages.title: Pagi Bersama Lala
pages.text: Pagi itu, Lala datang dengan riang. “Ayo ke taman!” katanya. Sepatu Merah hampir bergoyang karena senang.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Lala, a cheerful Indonesian girl around four years old with warm brown skin, a short straight black bob, round dark-brown eyes and a sunflower-yellow headband, wearing mint-green short overalls over a white T-shirt, kneels happily by the low shoe rack and reaches for the same cherry-red sneakers with cream soles and tiny golden dot eyes, sunny home entryway, excited gentle mood, soft hand-painted 2D children's picture-book illustration, no text.

pages.title: Langkah Pertama
pages.text: Lala memakai Sepatu Merah. Tap, tap, tap! Mereka melangkah keluar. Udara pagi terasa segar.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Lala, the same four-year-old Indonesian girl with warm brown skin, short black bob, yellow headband and mint-green short overalls, steps out of her cozy home wearing the cherry-red sneakers with cream soles, her first step lively and proud, small front garden and sunny neighborhood path, fresh morning mood, soft hand-painted 2D children's picture-book illustration, no text.

pages.title: Berlari di Taman
pages.text: Di taman, Lala mulai berlari. Sepatu Merah melaju ringan. Rumput, bunga, dan kupu-kupu seakan ikut bersorak.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Lala, unchanged with yellow headband, mint-green short overalls and cherry-red sneakers, runs joyfully along a curved path in a bright neighborhood park, rounded green grass, colorful flowers and a few butterflies around her, red shoes clearly visible in motion, energetic but gentle, soft hand-painted 2D children's picture-book illustration, no text.

pages.title: Lompatan Besar
pages.text: Di depan mereka ada genangan air. “Siap?” tanya Lala. Satu, dua, tiga—hop! Mereka berhasil melompatinya.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Lala, the same cheerful Indonesian preschool girl in yellow headband and mint-green short overalls, leaps safely over one shallow sparkling puddle on the park path, both cherry-red sneakers with cream soles clearly airborne, delighted expression, a few playful water droplets and flowers nearby, soft hand-painted 2D children's picture-book illustration, no text.

pages.title: Suara Kecil
pages.text: Tiba-tiba terdengar, “Meong... meong...” Lala berhenti. Di bawah bangku, seekor anak kucing tampak kebingungan.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Lala, unchanged in yellow headband, mint-green short overalls and red sneakers, stops beside a wooden park bench and kneels to look underneath, where a tiny orange-and-white kitten with a white muzzle, white front paws and a teal collar peeks out looking lost but safe, caring discovery, soft hand-painted 2D children's picture-book illustration, no text.

pages.title: Mencari Ibu Kucing
pages.text: “Kamu mencari ibumu?” tanya Lala. Anak kucing mengangguk. Lala dan Sepatu Merah pun siap membantu.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Lala, the same Indonesian girl in yellow headband, mint-green short overalls and cherry-red sneakers, gently offers one hand to the tiny orange-and-white kitten with teal collar beside the park bench, kitten steps out and looks hopeful, clear caring promise to help, sunny park garden, soft hand-painted 2D children's picture-book illustration, no text.

pages.title: Jejak di Tanah
pages.text: Mereka menemukan jejak kaki kecil di tanah. Jejak itu melewati bunga-bunga dan menuju pohon besar.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Lala, unchanged in mint-green short overalls and cherry-red sneakers, walks slowly with the orange-and-white kitten beside her while pointing to a trail of small pawprints in soft earth, pawprints lead past colorful flowers toward a large rounded shade tree, simple visual clue, curious helpful mood, soft hand-painted 2D children's picture-book illustration, no text.

pages.title: Pita Biru
pages.text: Di dekat pohon, Lala melihat pita biru tersangkut di ranting. Pita itu sama dengan pita pada kalung si anak kucing.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Lala, the same preschool girl with yellow headband, mint-green short overalls and red sneakers, stands beside the large park tree and gently points to a small teal-blue ribbon caught on a low branch, the orange-and-white kitten with matching teal collar looks up, clear matching-color clue, soft hand-painted 2D children's picture-book illustration, no text.

pages.title: Akhirnya Bertemu
pages.text: Dari balik pohon muncul Ibu Kucing. “Meong!” Anak kucing berlari memeluknya. Lala ikut tersenyum lega.
pages.illustrationPrompt: The tiny orange-and-white kitten with teal collar happily reunites with its mother, a gentle larger orange-and-white cat wearing a matching teal ribbon, beside the large park tree; Lala, unchanged in yellow headband, mint-green short overalls and cherry-red sneakers, smiles with relief nearby, warm reunion, soft hand-painted 2D children's picture-book illustration, no text.

pages.title: Sepatu yang Bangga
pages.text: Sepatu Merah sedikit berdebu. Namun ia merasa sangat bangga. Hari itu, langkahnya telah membawa kebaikan.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Lala sits on the edge of the park path and looks fondly at her slightly dusty cherry-red sneakers with cream soles and tiny friendly golden dot eyes, the shoes appear proud and content while the reunited cats walk safely together in the background, warm late-afternoon light, soft hand-painted 2D children's picture-book illustration, no text.

pages.title: Perjalanan Terbaik
pages.text: Di rumah, Lala membersihkan Sepatu Merah lalu menaruhnya kembali di rak. Perjalanan terbaik bukan yang paling jauh, tetapi yang membawa kebaikan.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Inside the same cozy home entryway at golden evening, Lala, unchanged with warm brown skin, short black bob, yellow headband and mint-green short overalls, gently wipes the clean cherry-red sneakers with a soft cloth before placing them together on the low wooden rack, shoes' tiny golden dot eyes look peaceful and proud, warm restful ending, soft hand-painted 2D children's picture-book illustration, no text.

quizQuestion.question: Mengapa perjalanan Lala menjadi istimewa?
options: Karena Lala membantu anak kucing menemukan ibunya
quizQuestion.explanation: Perjalanan itu istimewa karena Lala dan Sepatu Merah menggunakan langkah mereka untuk membantu anak kucing.

productionGuide.coverPrompt: Lala, a cheerful Indonesian preschool girl with warm brown skin, short straight black bob, round dark-brown eyes, sunflower-yellow headband, mint-green short overalls and white T-shirt, runs joyfully through a colorful neighborhood park wearing a pair of cherry-red sneakers with cream soles and tiny friendly golden dot eyes, a small orange-and-white kitten with teal collar runs safely beside her, flowers and a shallow puddle nearby, emotional promise of movement and kindness, soft hand-painted 2D children's picture-book cover illustration, rounded shapes, subtle paper texture, edge-to-edge portrait composition, no typography or readable text.
continuityRules: Gunakan desain, proporsi, pakaian, dan warna pada character bible tanpa perubahan.
Lala selalu memakai bando kuning, overall hijau mint, dan kaus putih.
Sepatu Merah selalu berupa sepasang sneaker merah ceri dengan sol krem dan mata titik emas kecil; jangan beri mulut atau anggota tubuh tambahan.
Mimi selalu berbulu jingga-putih dengan kedua kaki depan putih dan kalung teal.
Pertahankan taman sebagai taman lingkungan yang cerah, aman, hijau, dan ramah anak.
Gunakan gaya lukisan 2D lembut, bentuk membulat, tekstur kertas halus, dan warna cerah yang tidak terlalu jenuh.
Jangan memasukkan tulisan, huruf, angka, balon percakapan, logo, atau watermark ke dalam ilustrasi.
productionGuide.negativePrompt: photorealistic, 3D render, horror, danger, traffic, injury, threatening animal, dirty unsafe puddle, readable text, letters, numbers, caption, speech bubble, logo, signature, watermark, extra limbs, duplicate child, duplicate kitten, changed clothing, changed hair, different shoe color, shoes with arms or legs, shoes with mouth, inconsistent proportions

checklist: Bacakan naskah dengan lantang dan pastikan panjang kalimat nyaman untuk usia 3-5 tahun.
Pastikan Lala, Sepatu Merah, Mimi, pakaian, warna, dan proporsi konsisten pada setiap ilustrasi.
Pastikan Sepatu Merah tetap terlihat sebagai sepasang sneaker dan tidak memiliki anggota tubuh tambahan.
Pastikan adegan genangan dan pencarian anak kucing terasa aman bagi anak kecil.
Pastikan seluruh gambar bebas tulisan, logo, dan watermark sebelum dipublikasikan.
Tinjau pertanyaan pemahaman pada halaman terakhir.
